title: Make Chat side panels responsive and content-aware
description:
Problem: the deeper `/chat` trace-sidebar review showed an empty Trace panel consuming nearly half of the available width on a narrow viewport. The main chat shell, model controls, composer, and message stream were compressed even though the side panel only showed `No turn selected` and `No trace events.`

Desired outcome: Chat side panels should adapt to available space and content value, making traces/history easy to access without reducing the primary conversation area when there is little to show.

Scope:
- In scope: responsive sidebar widths, auto-collapse or drawer behavior for empty panels, trace/history empty-state hierarchy, close/toggle discoverability, and interaction with composer layout work in TSK-0125.
- Out of scope: changing trace event schema or chat history persistence.

Acceptance criteria:
- Empty Trace/History panels do not permanently consume large portions of narrow viewports.
- When trace data exists, the panel can expand or focus without hiding critical composer controls.
- The side-panel state is easy to understand and close/reopen.
- Sidebar behavior remains stable across Chat and Agent modes.

Validation:
- Capture `/chat` with sidebar closed, history open, empty trace open, and populated trace if fixture data is available.
- Run focused browser checks for sidebar toggle, Trace/History tab switching, and composer usability at narrow width.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 deeper live review: an empty Chat Trace side panel took substantial width and compressed the primary chat/composer area.
